receipt.title: Thanks for going Pro!

receipt.active: Your Pro status is active until {{until}} (WIB).
receipt.capUnlimited: With Pro you can scan meals with no daily limit.
receipt.capLimited_one: With Pro you can scan up to {{count}} meal a day with AI.
receipt.capLimited_other: With Pro you can scan up to {{count}} meals a day with AI.

receipt.activeKeluarga: Joyo Keluarga is active until {{until}} (WIB). Invite up to {{count}} people in your household from Profile > Subscription.

ending.subject: Your Pro ends on {{until}}
ending.intro: Hi {{name}}, your Pro plan ends on {{until}} (WIB).
ending.renew: Renew now so your daily nutrition scans don't stop.

expired.subject: Your Pro has ended
expired.intro: Hi {{name}}, your Pro plan has ended, so daily scans are back to the free limit.
expired.reactivate: You can turn Pro back on anytime to keep scanning without worrying about the limit.

keluargaEnding.subject: Your Joyo Keluarga ends {{until}}
keluargaEnding.intro: Hi {{name}}, your Joyo Keluarga runs until {{until}} (WIB). After that Pro stops for everyone in your household until you pay again.
keluargaEnding.renew: QRIS/bank transfer payments do not renew automatically. Renew to keep your household on Pro. The members stay saved.

keluargaRemoved.subject: You are no longer in {{owner}}'s Joyo Keluarga
keluargaRemoved.intro: Hi {{name}}, {{owner}} removed you from their Joyo Keluarga. Pro from that household has stopped on your account.
keluargaRemoved.data: Your food, weight and sleep logs stay on your account and stay private.
keluargaRemoved.pro: If you still want Pro, you can get Joyo Pro yourself at any time.
